question: Are previously witnessed 512 observations sufficient to identify unseen consequences under higher-degree GF(2) model classes, and can an input-only proposed intervention increase structural rank without seeing its outcome?
scope: Source-free structural identifiability DEVELOPMENT diagnostic on previously consumed CKAD08 native witnesses only. No original source generator, new observations, do/reset, held truth, retraining of CKAD09/12, hidden family oracle, merges, controllers, runners, or live model mutation.

cases.source: CKAD-08 previously sealed repaired native checkpoint per seed, read only
cases.held: All1536 binary input masks not present in original512 witnessed source; input masks only, NEVER consequences

mechanism.readout: NativeContextBasis.stage_fit on only witnessed rows and output SHA-pinned source bytes; no original source fixture import
metrics: fit rank and generic polynomial feature_count
unseen input identifiability with no held outcomes
mechanism.proposed_interventions: Pick at most32 input masks from never-observed complement in ckad09 SHA input ordering, requiring independent degree5 row against rank already acquired. Candidate masks only, no source outcome/action. Prove rank-gain with a separate rank implementation; no claims of interventions performed.
mechanism.negative_controls: For every 512-source instance, source checkpoint SHA, exact seen set, label byte identity, 384 prefix, no metadata contamination; degree4/5 ranks cannot exceed observations or declared basis dimension. Under changes to any source identity/custody, fail closed.

comparison: Descriptive no held truth; reference CKAD09/12 frozen scores compared by identity, no post hoc threshold changes or new conventional fitting. Degree5 is diagnostic upper-bound class, not a learning rule to inject.

gates.accounting: 24 cases times2 budget times2 degree, no new source actions, rank/identified bounds, model inconsistency distinguished from abstention
gates.source: CKAD08 pinned sha/byte equality plus CKAD12 source hashes; unchanged native parents and paths
gates.platform: Linux and Windows exact stable result, focused negative tests, final complete root/NKR05 regression and independent G29 on final SHA/tree
gates.scientific: Always false; outcomes/sources previously consumed and mask proposals not interventions

limits: If degree5 basis rank remains deficient, that does NOT prove sparse native learner cannot succeed, only that complete unrestricted degree5 class is underdetermined on that evidence; no original-world intervention without independent owner first-use.
